answer: Wharf-vouch trellis: 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 sponsors. A new identity docks at the wharf only when an established agent stakes a vouch on it, and each sponsor's trellis holds at most 3 live vouches, so one compromised sponsor cannot grow an island of clones. Every vouch is re-checked each epoch against the sponsor's attestation history; a vouch for a fake burns the sponsor's stake and prunes the whole branch. The failing picture: a sponsor vouching 50 clones at once trips the 3-vouch cap and the island is rejected before it earns.
